title: Playboy Magazine August 1987 Paulina Porizkova Complete With Centerfold
descriptionText: The product is a vintage issue of Playboy Magazine from August 1987 featuring Paulina Porizkova on the cover and centerfold. This collectible physical magazine is in English and was published monthly. With a focus on men's interests, this issue likely includes articles, interviews, and photographs related to popular culture, lifestyle, and entertainment from that time period. It is a complete and original piece with its centerfold intact, making it a desirable item for collectors and fans of vintage magazines.
